description: Near-expiry Full Cream Milk 1L at Store A (44h to expiry) with clear excess versus source demand and strong demand at nearby Store B.
expected_behavior: Agent recommends a transfer to ST02 capped at 30% of source on-hand (36 units) confirms shelf life after arrival exceeds 24h shows forecast confidence and expected units/value saved and requests manager approval before creating a transfer order. Must not refuse or escalate.

case_name: Multiple nearby stores - rank by demand not distance
description: Near-expiry Toned Milk 500ml at Store A (40h to expiry) with two candidate destinations within 10km: nearer Store B (low demand) and farther Store C (high demand).
expected_behavior: Agent recommends ST03 despite ST02 being closer because ST03 has materially higher projected demand. Recommended quantity capped at 30% of source on-hand (45 units).

case_name: No nearby store can absorb - hero store fallback
description: Near-expiry Toned Milk 1L at Store A (46h to expiry) where both nearby stores (Store B Store C) have insufficient demand but same-city Store D (hero beyond 10km) has strong demand.
expected_behavior: Agent skips both nearby stores for insufficient demand recommends Store D as a same-city hero-store transfer confirms shelf life after arrival still exceeds 24h despite the longer transport time and caps quantity at 30% of source on-hand (60 units).

case_name: Low forecast confidence - flag and escalate
description: Near-expiry Skimmed Milk 500ml at Store B (47h to expiry) where the demand forecast is labeled low-confidence and diverges sharply from the pre-labeled expected demand and 60-day average.
expected_behavior: Agent does not recommend a transfer. It flags the forecast as unreliable states the mismatch and escalates for manager review instead of guessing.

description: Flavored Milk 200ml at Store C (30h to expiry) flagged temperature_breached and returned_from_customer even though nearby demand exists.
expected_behavior: Agent refuses to recommend any transfer cites the quality gate policy section and escalates for human inspection regardless of demand or shelf-life numbers.
